#### Clase `weakref_finalize` (Línea 17)
- **Docstring:** _Class for finalization of weakrefable objects
finalize(obj, func, *args, **kwargs) returns a callable finalizer
object which will be called when obj is garbage collected. The
first time the finalizer is called it evaluates func(*arg, **kwargs)
and returns the result. After this the finalizer is dead, and
calling it just returns None.
When the program exits any remaining finalizers for which the
atexit attribute is true will be run in reverse order of creation.
By default atexit is true._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __init__(self, obj, func)` (Línea 43): Sin docstring.
  - `def __call__(self, _)` (Línea 61): If alive then mark as dead and return func(*args, **kwargs);
otherwise return None
  - `def detach(self)` (Línea 68): If alive then mark as dead and return (obj, func, args, kwargs);
otherwise return None
  - `def peek(self)` (Línea 76): If alive then return (obj, func, args, kwargs);
otherwise return None
  - `def alive(self)` (Línea 85): Whether finalizer is alive
  - `def atexit(self)` (Línea 90): Whether finalizer should be called at exit
  - `def atexit(self, value)` (Línea 96): Sin docstring.
